text_block_list.text:
One day, upon arriving in front of the 
school gate――

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Alright, time to hit the perimeter~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
You doing the outer loop now too? Then how 
'bout you and me go head-to-head!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, Hishi Ama-san!? Wait, 
head-to-head... you mean a race!?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! If you're just getting started, your 
condition oughta be in top shape.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I've been wanting to see what you're made 
of. Come on, hit me with everything you've 
got!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Wait, hold on... eeeeeeeh~!?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
*Haa*... *haa*... Final... 
straightaway...! I'm, at my limit... but, 
if I can pass her here...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Heh, making your move, are you?! Fine by 
me, come at me! I'll crush you with 
everything I've got!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... No way, she's pulling away even 
more!? Still, still, even I'm not gonna... 
give up...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Uwaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
*Haa*... *haa*... *pant*... Aah... 
Figures, no good after all... *haa*...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Good work, Nature!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
*Phew*... As expected, piece of cake, for 
you, huh... Man, Hishi Ama-san, you're 
super, fast... *sigh*.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Your run was great too! I'm totally 
satisfied that we got to battle on even 
terms!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
No way, I didn't... I mean, the outcome 
was obvious right from the start.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
What're you talking about? You made your 
move at the turn and went all out trying 
to overtake me, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I felt your spirit loud and clear! I love 
people who burn with fire like that!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Eeeeek! N-Not burning at all, I swear! 
Oww, please spare me any more of that~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, don't be shy! Well, I'm going for 
one more lap. Let's do this again 
sometime!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Aah... that was so embarrassing. I mean, 
going for another lap... her stamina is 
insane...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
There's no way I can match someone like 
that. No way at all... and yet...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Guess I'll run a bit more too.
